tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Income Tax Department has issued a Re-assessment Order dated March 12, 2026 on March 20, 2026 under section 143(3) read with section 147 of the Act, pertaining to Tata Capital Financial Services Limited (now merged with Tata Capital Limited with appointed date April 1, 2023) for the financial year 2017-18, wherein demand of Rs. 413.18 crore (including interest of Rs. 202.72 crore) is raised primarily on account of short credit of taxes paid of Rs. 209.52 crore & consequential erroneous interest levied, and certain disallowances.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed a rectification application with the Income-tax Assessing Officer on March 24, 2026 to rectify errors apparent from the record in the order, which is currently pending disposal. Further, the Company has filed an appeal before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) on April 10, 2026, against the said re-assessment order to contest the disallowances and the errors apparent from record. The rectification order is expected shortly with substantial reduction in the tax demand and it is believed there will be no impact on the financials, operations or other activities of the Company.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹8,160.1 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹1,502.02 Cr.
Tata Capital reported 99% utilization of its ₹6,846 Cr IPO fresh issue proceeds as of March 31, 2026.
Tata Capital Limited shared the recording of its April 23, 2026, media call and earnings conference call for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website.
On April 29, 2026, Tata Capital filed the earnings call transcript for Q4 and FY26, reporting consolidated AUM of ₹2.77 lakh Cr and ex-TMF PAT of ₹1,459 Cr.
Tata Capital issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for material related party transactions with Tata Steel up to ₹15,060 Cr for FY27.
On May 12, 2026, Tata Capital allotted 50,500 secured redeemable NCDs aggregating to ₹505 crore at a 7.97% coupon maturing in May 2031.
On June 5, 2026, Tata Capital announced shareholder approval for up to ₹15,060 Cr in material related party transactions with Tata Steel via postal ballot.
On October 19, 2026, Tata Capital scheduled its Q2FY27 earnings conference call for October 27, 2026.

Revised intimation of earnings conference call for Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, scheduled Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. IST.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹9,341.81 Cr (+20.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1,659.87 Cr.
Tata Capital reported Q2FY27 net AUM of ₹3,08,030 Cr and PAT of ₹1,660 Cr.
